reasoning: The image shows a soybean stem split open longitudinally with the outer stem still green (living plant) but the internal pith showing clear brown/orange-brown discoloration. This is the hallmark diagnostic symptom of Brown Stem Rot. Sudden Death Syndrome is ruled out because SDS pith remains white. Charcoal Rot is ruled out because it shows very dark/black charcoal-like discoloration with microsclerotia. All other stem diseases do not present with this specific brown pith pattern in a green stem.
